title: Road drive, 6.5 min, two bursts of wheelspin
about: 10 November 2026, BMW E39, phone lying flat. Recorded with app 0.5.0: the drift angle logged on the phone wandered with the compass, the replay works it out again. Shown while the car moves.

title: Drift run 1, 80 s

title: Drift run 2, 70 s

title: Drift run 3, 3.5 min
